chunks: From him, from Abu Ja'far, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, that he saw Abu al-Hasan al-Thani (peace be upon him) throwing the Jamarat while he was riding, until he threw all of them.
He saw Abu al-Hasan al-Thani (peace be upon him) throwing the Jamarat while he was riding, until he threw all of them.

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الثَّانِي: Abu al-Hasan al-Thani (Imam Ali al-Naqi, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to throw the Jamarat stones while riding a horse or camel during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from *al-Istibsar* highlights the practical flexibility (*rukhas*) granted in Shia jurisprudence, allowing pilgrims to perform the stoning of the Jamarat while mounted to accommodate ease and avoid hardship. It specifically cites Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) throwing all stones while riding, establishing a precedent that the ritual remains valid even when the pilgrim is not dismounted, provided the action is performed with intention and accuracy.
